# AL1219: Use *Any* string comparison extension

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/ANcpLua.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| Property | Value |
| -- | -- |
| Severity | Warning |
| Category | `Roslyn Utilities` |
| Code fix | No |
| Analyzer | `Al1219UseStringComparisonAnyExtensionsAnalyzer` |

## Description

Chained string equality comparisons (s == "a" \|\| s == "b") can be collapsed into a single EqualsAnyOrdinal/EqualsAnyIgnoreCase call.
